Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh have won the series by going 2-0 up but join us back for the final match on 14th March at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT) and earlier for the build up. Till then, cheers!
Shakib Al Hasan says they bowled really well, the spinners restricted England well but overall a good team effort. Adds Najmul Hossain Shanto and Mehidy Hasan played really well.

Mehidy Hasan is the Player of the Match. He says he is happy to play the match after some time and was a bit confused but credits staff to back him up. Adds the pitch was assisting the spinners so he tried to keep the ball in the right areas.

Jos Buttler says it was a different game of cricket but credits to Bangladesh for the way they played. Adds it was a tough wicket to bat on and he hoped someone to stick till the end. Applauds the performance of his bowlers as they gave their all.
...Presentation next...

The pitch was tough to bat on and England were a victim on it. The home team knew the pitch and bowled accordingly keeping England down to a below-par score. Mehidy Hasan claimed four and was the pick of the bowlers but it was their fielding which lifted Bangladesh up. Jos Buttler surely didn't see this coming at the start of the match.

What a win! Bangladesh will be full of confidence after this series win. They had a low score to chase and to be honest, we thought, Bangladesh will chase down it easily but England took it down the wire however Najmul Hossain Shanto played a vital knock. He just stayed there till the end and anchor the innings.. It did feel like England will defend this but Taskin Ahmed hammered their hopes. You cannot blame the English bowlers much, they had a low score to defend and they tried their best.

History has been created! Bangladesh have outplayed England not just in this match but in both matches. England would have given a real fight had they got 20-30 runs more. Credit to Bangladesh though for the way they bowl.
FOUR! History created by Bangladesh! Length and outside off, Ahmed slaps it over covers for four. What a win. Bangladesh win by 4 wickets.
FOUR! BANG! Bangladesh are nearing! Length and outside off, Ahmed swings and hits it over covers for a boundary. 2 runs needed now.
Short again on leg, Shanto pulls it to deep square leg for a single. 6 runs needed now.
On the pads, this is clipped to deep square leg for two.
FOUR! SHOT! A slower length ball, on leg. Shanto pulls it behind square leg and beats the man at the deep. 9 runs needed now.
A bouncer on off, Ahmed ducks under it.

OUT! BOWLED! Jofra Archer has turned up the heat! They have not given up! This is on a length and around middle and off. Hossain swings without much foot movement and misses. The ball goes through and hits the stumps.
Short and on middle, pulled to mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, Shanto tries to dab it away but finds short third man.
Length and on middle, Hossain dabs it to third man for one.
Short in length and around off, Shanto pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for one.

OUT! TAKEN! England have not given up yet! Tossed up on middle. Al Hasan tries to loft it over long off but without much power and Chris Jordan holds onto it in the deep.Slight pressure on Bangladesh.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: 100 up! On middle, Shanto cuts it to deep point for one more.
Flat and on off, Shanto tucks it to square leg for a couple.
On off, kept out.
This is full and outside off, driven to mid off.
This is short and outside off, Al Hasan tries to ride the bounce but misses.
OUT! GONE! Hasan goes! Short and around off, Hasan looks to pull but he mistimes it completely. Hasan slices and it goes to mid-wicket where Adil Rashid takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Jofra Archer

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length and on middle, knocked to point.
This is full and outside off, Hasan inside edges his drive to square leg for a single.
This one lands outside off and spins away. Shanto defends the wrong line.
FOUR! That is played really well! Fuller and outside off, Shanto reverse hits it well over short third man for a boundary.
Flat and outside off, Hasan plays it to square leg for one.
SIX! SHOT! This is full and outside off, Hasan slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Slower, and spins back in, outside off, Hasan keeps it out.
On the pads, tucked to square leg for one.
Too full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR BYES! Bowls it slightly shorter and on off, it turns in, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to play at it but misses. The keeper misses as well as the ball races away from the fine leg fence.
Bowls it outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to cut it but gets beaten.

Lands it outside off, it skids through, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to reverse sweep it but misses and gets rapped on his pads. A loud appeal, but turned down. Jos Buttler goes upstairs. The replay shows that it was just clipping the stumps and the onfield decision stands NOT OUT!
Bowls it on off, Mehidy Hasan taps it to covers for one.
SIX! Up and over. Full and on off, Mehidy Hasan moves forward and lofts it over extra covers for a maximum.
Full and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to reverse sweep but gets a bottom edge as the ball rolls towards fine leg. They collect two.
Lands it on leg, Mehidy Hasan flicks it to square leg for one.
Lands it outside off, Mehidy Hasan pushes it to the man at covers.
Too full, on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto turns it to mid-wicket for one more.
Lands it on off, Mehidy Hasan knocks it to mid on for one.
Full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it outside off, Mehidy Hasan looks to play at it but misses.
Wide! Lands it down leg, Mehidy Hasan misses his flick.
Slower one, on middle, Mehidy Hasan blocks it back.
Bowls it on off, Mehidy Hasan flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Wide! Lands it down leg, Mehidy Hasan misses his flick.
Another single as this is played towards mid-wicket.
Bowls it on off, Mehidy Hasan tucks it to mid on for one more.
Too full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it to covers for one.
Lands it on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Quicker one, on off, Mehidy Hasan tucks it to mid-wicket for one more.
Bowls it on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto knocks it to long on for one.
Shorter and on off, Mehidy Hasan pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Mehidy Hasan walks in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Rehan Ahmed strikes in his very first over. Short and wide, it turns away as well, Towhid Hridoy looks to cut it but mistimes it completely as it lobs straight into the hands of Chris Woakes at point. A wicket on debut for Rehan Ahmed!
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Woakes b Rehan Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it to mid-wicket for one.

Drinks! Bangladesh have started on the slower side but it is the need of the hour. A decent stand will help them get over the line. For England though, they need wickets and need to put pressure on Bangladesh.
Bowls it on off, with some turn, Towhid Hridoy looks to loft it but doesn't connect well as the ball rolls towards mid off. Dot.
FOUR! Excellent placement. Full and outside off, Towhid Hridoy picks it well and lofts it over extra covers as the ball races away from the fence.
Tossed up, on off, Towhid Hridoy pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Fine shot. Full and on off, Towhid Hridoy hangs back and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Flatter and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it to mid on for one.
Lands it outside off, Towhid Hridoy flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it outside off, Towhid Hridoy reverse paddles it to third man for one.
Full and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto edges it to third man for one.
Bowls it on off, it turns away, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to play at it but misses.
Too full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it back.
Lands it on middle and leg, Towhid Hridoy paddles it to fine leg for one.
Bowls it on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto lofts it to long off for one.
Full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to square leg for one.
A googly, on middle, Towhid Hridoy tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Darts it on middle, Towhid Hridoy turns it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Flatter and on off, Towhid Hridoy eases it back towards the bowler.
Full and on off, Towhid Hridoy miscues his drive towards point. Dot.
Lands it on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto punches it to mid on for one.
Too full and on off, Towhid Hridoy blocks it back towards the bowler.
Sightly shorter one, Najmul Hossain Shanto reverse hits it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Turning in from outside off, Towhid Hridoy tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto slaps it towards point for one.
Lands it on off, Towhid Hridoy reverse sweeps it towards short third man for one.
Some turn and bounce, Towhid Hridoy blocks it solidly.
On a length, angling in, Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it back.
FOUR! Well-controlled shot! Shorter and wide, Najmul Hossain Shanto hangs back and guides it through backward point for a boundary!
Lands it outside off, shaping away, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to block it but gets beaten.
Bowls it on off, Towhid Hridoy flicks it to square leg for one.
Lands it on off, Towhid Hridoy blocks it away.
Towhid Hridoy comes out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Lands it short and on off, Rony Talukdar looks to pull it but mistimes it completely. It lobs in the air towards mid on. Moeen Ali runs behind and takes a fine catch. Bangladesh go two down in a jiffy.
Commentary.Howout: c Moeen Ali b Jofra Archer

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is defended out solidly.
Wide! Shorter and on leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone.
A single as this is pulled towards square leg.
Lands it outside off, Rony Talukdar looks to play at it but misses.
Lands it on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls it to square leg for one.
On a length and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it to covers for one.
Shorter and on off, Rony Talukdar pulls it towards deep square leg for one.
Leg bye! Slanting on the pads, Talukdar fails to flick but misses and it goes to square leg for one.
BEATEN! Superb from Archer! He will show his class with pace! An in-angler, goes around leg. Talukdar makes room to push but misses.
One more run as this is steered to third man by Shanto.
Short in length and around off, Talukdar pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
This is full and on off, Shanto defends it out.
Around off, Talukdar punches it to cover.
This one swings away , full and on off, Shanto jams it out to mid on for one.
Length and outside off, Shanto plays it fine but to short third man.
Najmul Hossain Shanto walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! Sam Curran has the first one! Curran continues to serve short, this is on middle. Das pulls it flat and hard but Philip Salt takes an excellent catch at deep square leg. This will help England in low scoring game.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off, Das dabs it to point.
On middle, this is nudged to mid-wicket for one more.
Leg bye! Tailing on the pads, Talukdar fails to clip and it goes to square leg for a leg bye.
QUICK SINGLE! Outside off, Das knocks it to point and races to the other end.
Short again, it is pulled to deep mid-wicket for two.
FOUR! Well played! This is short and on middle, Das pulls it to deep square leg for four.
Tad fuller and around off, Das works it to mid off.
On a length and on middle, Das blocks.
TAP AND RUN! Length and on off, dropped to point for one.
Short again, Talukdar looks to pull but mistimes it to point. A quick single is taken.
Shorter and outside off, Talukdar swings and misses.
FOUR! EDGED AWAY! A slower length ball, outside off, Talukdar tries to defend but gets an outside edge past the diving keeper and to the third man fence.
This is full and around off, Talukdar chips it to mid off where the fielder collects on a bounce.
Length ball, outside off, Das knocks it through covers for a single. Bangladesh are underway.
